title.narrative: Skills for Employment Investment Program Tranche 3

description.narrative: The proposed Tranche 3 (2020-2023) aims to harness and institutionalize training partnerships established under Tranches 1 and 2. It will continue to support sector-focused job-ready skills training through the existing partnerships with public institutes, industry associations and other organizations, covering skills requirements in 10 industry sectors. It will introduce selected advanced courses to adopt and adapt emerging Industry 4.0 skill requirements and help industries move up the value chain. It will also support new training specifically targeted at socially disadvantaged groups (including people with disabilities) and women entrepreneurs to ensure inclusive skilling efforts. Overall, Tranche 3 will train about 320,000 people, 30% of whom will be women. Tranche 3 will continue to support the operationalization of the National Skills Development Authority (NSDA) and the National Human Resource Development Fund (NHRDF) to sustain the SEIP efforts in building a strong skilled workforce.

description.narrative: Inclusive access to basic, mid-level, and advanced skills training for priority sectors increased.

About 25% of target trainees completed mid-level skills courses (30% female in the target) Achievement: 32.30 Progress/Status: Out of enrolled of 287,153 trainees, 83,911 were for mid-level skills and higher level training (29%). Of them, 25% were female. Data Source: TMS, executing agency progress reports

About 320,000 new entrants and existing workforce trained in 10 priority sectors (30% female in the target) Achievement: 272,061 Progress/Status: As of 31 Dec 2024, Total 287,153 trainees were enrolled (90% of the target) under 14 industry associations. Of which female were 91,896 or 32%. From the above-enrolled trainees, 261,458 trainees have so far been trained of whom 85,250 were female (33%) Data Source: TMS, executing agency progress reports Actual value: 272,061

At least 2,000 participants completed industry-specific middle-managerial training programs (15% female in the target) Achievement: 1650 Progress/Status: Total 2,011 trainees were enrolled (101% of the target for completion) in four universities (BUTEX, BRAC-U, EWU and IBA Dhaka University) and a government agency (BIGM) and completed EDC program. Of them 322 were female (16%). Of the enrolled, 1,739 trainees (female: 19%) were certified. Data Source: TMS, executing agency progress reports

At least 25 new advanced courses introduced for seven priority sectors Achievement: 25 Progress/Status: 26 advanced courses were introduced and implemented in seven sectors consisting eight industry associations for both new entrants (14 courses) and existing workers (or up-skilling 12 courses) Data Source: TMS, executing agency progress reports
